By weaponizing the looping energy signature of Mobius Fuel, you have engineered an alchemical explosive unlike any conventional TNT or industrial dynamite. The Nova Catalyst doesn't just indiscriminately destroy; it actively manipulates the physical space and kinetic forces around the blast zone. When detonated, the sheer concentration of alchemical energy temporarily warps the immediate gravitational field, ensuring that the chaos of the explosion is surprisingly orderly. It is a masterpiece of controlled, large-scale excavation.

Functionally, this explosive yields a massive blast with a 16-block radius. However, its greatest and most convenient feature is its post-detonation effect: it automatically gathers all the resulting dropped items and shattered blocks into a single, tightly packed sphere at the center of the crater. No more running around a massive, dangerous pit to collect your resources—the loot comes directly to you!
